For NVDA followers, the article notes that unresolved issues remain, including an independent investigation into reports that Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort, an SEC accounting probe, and a delayed quarterly filing, while the company's fiscal third-quarter revenue reached $115.84 billion and management raised its fiscal 2028 growth outlook to about 75%.
